request_flow.summary: The exact-raw HMAC webhook path validates the fixture vocabulary and resolves the original qualified payment transaction and reference. An independent connection must see the bounded receipt before acknowledgement.
The receipt worker locks the accepted purchase, binds the provider dispute identity, classifies revision or conflict and increments the durable effect version in the same transaction.
The owning Entitlements transaction re-reads the current source effect. Applied versions are acknowledged separately, so a cut between transactions leaves recoverable work.

The evidence projection checks exact scope proofs, canonical session, current Privacy purpose and both parties' deletion authority. Audit persists only the actor, purpose, case and fixed field-set assertion.

security_invariants.summary: Dispute wire, handlers, workers and state-changing Ash actions compile only in TEST. Network reads are GET to the original certificate-pinned loopback endpoint, without redirects or automatic retries.

The stored receipt contains only a digest, bounded normalized outcome data and a local bound payment identity. SQL query telemetry is suppressed on protected paths including the independent visibility observer.

concurrency.summary: The purchase lock is shared by dispute ingress, qualification, refund dispatch claim and entitlement convergence. A pending bound receipt or current blocking dispute fences a new POST. An existing claim remains durable and cannot be repeated.

idempotency_retry.summary: Dispute identity and immutable receipt identity are separate. Replays of earlier revisions or obsolete read tokens cannot advance the owning case. The durable scheduled retry remains capped and due after the final round.

failure_recovery.summary: Receipt processing, due known-case reads and pending consequences remain queryable by TEST workers after process loss or missing/discarded jobs. A separate process verifies fresh-BEAM recovery.
Down migrations refuse to discard retained dispute, Privacy or Audit evidence or suspended rights. Cleanup selects only the tracked operation, exact payment or webhook digest and their jobs.

prohibited_shortcuts.summary: Do not infer component identity from a partial amount, classify financial settlement from access state, retry a claimed POST or create a right during correction delivery.
Do not disclose raw participant information, send evidence outside NewYou, activate Paystack or discover unknown disputes.

proof_limitations: Actual Paystack account configuration, dispute status and deadline vocabulary, Finance operations and release certification remain out of scope.
The local fixture records unresolved overlapping corrections and does not decide cancellation, netting or external adjudication.

Ash Signals and Temporal Resources were considered. The existing versioned Commerce consequence and immutable receipts provide scoped durable recovery and historical evidence without process-local authority or new dependencies.
